known_mechanics: Delivery and New Born is a distinct benefit scope.
The benefit is subject to a 24-month waiting period.
The waiting period is anchored to first commencement and depends on continuous renewal.
A claim under Section II.14.A triggers a fresh 24-month waiting-period cycle.
Pre-hospitalization and post-hospitalization expenses are not applicable to this section.
Hospital Cash Benefit is not applicable to this section.
Delivery and New Born benefits are subject to limit tables whose exact values remain unresolved in the governed AR-3.0 slice.
required_limitations: Exact per-delivery table values by Sum Insured and delivery type are unresolved.
Exact New Born liability table values by Sum Insured are unresolved.
Section II.14 surrounding-clause completeness is not established.

guardrails: Education may explain governed known mechanics while explicitly naming material unknowns.
Education permission does not imply comparison readiness or customer applicability readiness.
A material product unknown must remain unresolved through alignment, sufficiency, and projection.
ACTION_REQUIRED must not be softened into READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS when a material product fact is unknown.
The decision projection must not choose, rank, recommend, or imply a net product direction.
No unresolved limit value may be inferred from transitional intelligence or historical comparison artifacts.
